summary: Full end-to-end verification of nuura protein-tracker. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass including Gemini 2.5 Flash vision /api/analyze with a real food JPEG. Frontend: onboarding modal appears on first launch, calculator → apply-goal → header pill updates to 116g, all 5 top tabs + 5 bottom tabs work, Snap/Upload buttons render, goal persists across reload via backend profile.

issues: React Native Web deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — use 'boxShadow'. Cosmetic only, does not affect functionality.

action_items: (Optional) Address RN-Web 'shadow*' deprecation by switching to boxShadow or wrapping with Platform.select to silence console warnings.

(Optional) Expo advises aligned package versions: @react-native-async-storage/async-storage@2.2.0, expo-image-picker@~17.0.11, react-native-svg@15.12.1. App works on current versions but Expo prints a warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py correctly excludes Mongo _id via projection {"_id": 0} — no ObjectId leakage.
All URLs/keys loaded from env vars; EMERGENT_LLM_KEY guarded with 500 if missing.
analyze endpoint uses robust JSON extraction (fenced + fallback regex) and clamps protein to 0–300.
All interactive elements have testID (snap/pick/tabs/inputs/goal cards/apply-goal).
GET /api/profile returns raw null with 200 — works because pydantic Optional response_model serialises null; frontend handles it.
seed_data_creation: Test users prefixed TEST_* created and torn down in pytest. One real user (u_1777884922705_*) was created in the frontend via onboarding flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; all endpoints prefixed /api. Gemini 2.5 Flash vision works via emergentintegrations. Use /tmp/food_b64.txt (real JPEG with features) for /api/analyze testing; blank images are forbidden per /app/image_testing.md. Frontend is a single screen /app/frontend/app/index.tsx; first-launch onboarding only shows when no profile exists for the device-generated user_id stored in AsyncStorage (key 'nuura_user_id').
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. App implementation is sound end-to-end.
